'''Ross Spires''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[March 2000 Knoxville tournament]] on 5 March 2000, according to Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d308">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-reportd308/ knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-report], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 5 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-knoxville-tn-3-5-00-td-reportd308/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
